structured.answer: I haven't decided anything and I'm not moving money. מק"מ ('a short loan to the State… sold by בנק ישראל') and government bonds sound as safe as my deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank how much they pay compared to it. The page itself shows no interest rates and nothing about bank fees.
